_comment: Tier-3 (mocked-completion + mocked-embedding) corpus for the memory processor (v4 processTurnForMemory). The COMPLETION call is pinned by rules keyed on (pass, CONTEXT-footer label, model, autonomous-clause presence): the jest oracle's createLLMProvider mock resolves each real call to a rule, RECORDS the exact (provider|model|temperature|messages) canned key it answered, and the Rust side replays those recorded entries through CannedCompletionProvider — so a prompt/selection/temperature divergence surfaces as a canned-miss, byte-exact. The EMBEDDING call is pinned by exact `summary\n\ncontent` text, as in the memory-gate corpus. Vector geometry: 13-dim unit basis vectors; each seed is s*e_k + sqrt(1-s^2)*e_spare so dot(candidate e_k, seed) == s exactly.
_safety: testPepperBase64 is the same THROWAWAY key the other fixtures use — never a real pepper.
_profileIdNote: Connection-profile ids MUST be well-formed UUIDs. Since v4 0cde7fbc, `LLMLogSchema.connectionProfileId` is `UUIDSchema.nullable().optional()` and the cheap-LLM execution path stamps `selection.connectionProfileId` onto every row, so placeholder ids like the old 'p-cur'/'p-cheap'/'p-unc'/'p-epi' make v4's repository REFUSE every llm_logs create (Zod 'Invalid UUID', swallowed by logLLMCall's catch). The oracle then finds no llm_logs table at all — the P4.40 escalation. Keep these UUID-shaped.

calls.$comment: P4.D136 (v4 a1d88aa3a, bug 107): Aria's SELF extraction pass TIMES OUT while every other pass answers. Aria's SELF pass AND Bram's OTHER pass both time out, so the result must carry passesLostToTimeout: 2 and BOTH SELF debug lines (v4 pushes the new LOST line and then falls through to the existing `failed` line), while `success` stays true — which is exactly the shape that used to report a clean finish over a hole in the data. dryRun so no memory rows are written and the existing table comparands are untouched. The OTHER arm is the other half: v4 REWROTE its existing sentence to interpolate `was LOST to a timeout` in place of `failed`, one line rather than the SELF arm's two.
